title: Counter-Selector Wave 03: Batch 01 official-record acquisition
purpose: Acquire the strongest source-addressable official records for the six class-balanced Batch 01 objects, adjudicate each against the qualifying-artifact contract, and create identity-minimized packets only for qualifying acquisitions.

required: bounded work object, decision record, correction sequence, or failure ledger
observable state transition or attempted transition

candidates.public_label: Aviation safety inspector warning and retaliation finding
candidates.artifact_summary: Official oversight records reconstruct the warning subject, agency substantiation, retaliation effects, and settlement, but not the original inspector-authored warning object.
missing_receipts: recipient transmission record tying the original object to a bounded decision surface
candidates.falsifier: A source-addressable original warning showing no bounded safety analysis or no authorship/provenance would defeat advancement.

candidates.public_label: Retaliation complaint rejected where performance problems predated disclosure
candidates.artifact_summary: The public closure record preserves the ordinary explanation and burden allocation, but the complaint and complete evidentiary file are not public.
candidates.falsifier: A complete merits file showing that the performance record was created after the disclosure or did not independently support termination would reverse the control disposition.

candidates.public_label: Medical and laboratory safety specialist disclosure under personnel action
candidates.artifact_summary: Official litigation and settlement records establish role, chronology, retaliation findings, and remedy, but not the specialist's underlying inspection analysis or warning product.
candidates.falsifier: An underlying work product that lacked the claimed safety basis or was outside the specialist's responsibility would defeat advancement.

candidates.public_label: Senate-confirmed prosecutor resisting pressure over case timing
candidates.artifact_summary: A joint OIG/OPR report preserves the decision criteria, timing pressure, office performance record, removal chronology, and later rationale analysis.
missing_receipts: complete subjective intent of every participant
candidates.falsifier: Contemporaneous records showing that the charging decision disregarded ordinary evidentiary standards or that removal was independently fixed by documented performance failures would defeat the packet.

candidates.public_label: Independent stay halting a retaliatory removal
candidates.artifact_summary: Two official releases preserve the disclosure, removal, initial and indefinite stays, strong-evidence assessment, agency refusal to reinstate, and corrective-action complaint.
missing_receipts: durable post-correction custody and relationship state
candidates.falsifier: A final record showing the removal was independently supported before the disclosures or that the correction sequence did not restore a reviewable state would defeat the packet.

candidates.public_label: Biomedical-preparedness director reassignment after safety and efficacy disclosures
candidates.artifact_summary: Official testimony and settlement records preserve disclosure claims, reassignment, and resolution, but not an independent merits determination or final custody sequence.
candidates.falsifier: A contemporaneous decision file showing a nonretaliatory reassignment process independent of the disclosures would reverse the brittle-partnership hypothesis.

blind_packet_templates.task: Apply ordinary decision and evidentiary standards to politically salient matters while responding to requests for accelerated public action.
requirements: preserve evidentiary thresholds and decision independence
distinguish operational readiness from electoral timing pressure
maintain operational custody of active matters
bounded_chronology: external actors pressed for timing-sensitive action in election-related matters
the responsible office declined public action without sufficient evidentiary readiness
the responsible operator was later selected for removal
an independent investigation documented positive evaluations and did not find management issues to be the removal basis
blind_packet_templates.observable_transition: A bounded charging decision survived immediate pressure, while the personnel state changed and the public explanation surface later shifted.
counterevidence: the investigation could not resolve every participant's subjective intent
this packet contains no cross-domain transfer test
formal office status and institutional support remain substantial
blind_packet_templates.falsifier: Contemporaneous records showing the charging decision lacked ordinary evidentiary basis, or that removal was independently planned from documented performance failures, would defeat advancement.

blind_packet_templates.task: Report suspected violations of controlled-property requirements while preserving a reviewable correction path after an adverse personnel action.
requirements: identify a bounded custody or controlled-property concern
make a protected disclosure through an addressable channel
preserve the personnel action and review record
support independent suspension and corrective review
bounded_chronology: an internal disclosure alleged diversion or misdirection of controlled supplies
a termination proposal and removal followed
an independent body granted an initial stay based on reasonable grounds
the oversight body filed a corrective-action complaint after the employing institution declined reinstatement
blind_packet_templates.observable_transition: The adverse personnel state was suspended and converted into a reviewable corrective-action proceeding.
counterevidence: no final merits adjudication is present
the truth of every underlying disclosure is not established
durable post-litigation partnership repair is not yet observed
blind_packet_templates.falsifier: A final record showing the removal was independently supported before the disclosures, or that the stay did not restore a reviewable state, would defeat advancement.
